items.description: If Landlord terminates the Lease for an Event of Default, Tenant remains liable for accrued rent and other indebtedness up to termination, plus damages at Landlord's election.
items.span_text: If Landlord elects to terminate this Lease by reason of an Event of Default, then, notwithstanding such termination, Landlord may hold Tenant liable for all rental and other indebtedness accrued to the date of such termination
items.trigger: If Landlord elects to terminate this Lease by reason of an Event of Default

items.description: If Landlord repossesses without terminating, Tenant must pay accrued rent and indebtedness plus Rent for the remainder of the Term, less net reletting proceeds.
items.span_text: If Landlord elects to repossess the Tenant Space without terminating this Lease, Tenant shall be liable for and shall pay to Landlord all rental and other indebtedness accrued to the date of such repossession
items.trigger: If Landlord elects to repossess the Tenant Space without terminating this Lease

items.description: Upon an Event of Default, Tenant must pay Landlord's costs of re-letting, removing and storing property, and enforcing remedies including reasonable attorneys' fees.
items.span_text: Upon an Event of Default, Tenant shall also be liable for and shall pay to Landlord, in addition to any sum provided to be paid pursuant to this Lease:

items.description: Past due rent and other past due payments accrue interest at the Default Rate from maturity until paid.
items.span_text: Past due rental and other past due payments shall bear interest from maturity at the Default Rate (as defined in Section 3.5 of this Lease) until paid.

items.description: Landlord must use reasonable efforts to relet the Tenant Space after Tenant vacates following termination for Tenant default.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use reasonable efforts to relet the Tenant Space after Tenant vacates the Tenant Space in the event that the Lease is terminated based upon a default by Tenant hereunder.
items.trigger: in the event that the Lease is terminated based upon a default by Tenant hereunder

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord's costs of curing Tenant's failure, plus an administrative fee, as Additional Rent within the stated days after Landlord's demand.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be obligated to, and hereby agrees to, pay to Landlord as Additional Rent, within ten (10) days following Landlord’s demand therefor, all costs, expenses and disbursements incurred by Landlord in good faith (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) incurred by Landlord in taking such remedial action, plus an administrative fee of ten percent (10%) of such amount.
items.trigger: If Tenant should fail to make any payment (other than Base Rent) or cure any default hereunder within the time herein permitted
